PT Lintas Batas Pembayaran (LBP), based in Jakarta, Indonesia, acts as a broker/intermediary for domestic institutions’ fiat and USDT conversion needs.

01

LBP’s role

LBP facilitates communication, quote requests and coordination between institutions and service partners. LBP is not a crypto asset trading operator or exchange.

02

Domestic institutions only

Services are for Indonesian domestic institutions that meet verification requirements. We do not serve individuals acting on their own behalf or foreign institutions. KYC for relevant people is part of institutional verification.

03

Scope of requirements

Discuss USD to USDT, IDR to USDT and USDT to IDR, with a minimum of USD 50,000 per transaction. Equivalent-value assessment and route availability follow confirmation and the relevant parties’ terms.

04

Partner relationships

The executing party and allocation of responsibilities are disclosed before approval. Partners and routes may support different conditions and networks. A partner’s name does not imply a guarantee or regulatory endorsement.

05

Start with your requirements

Share your institution’s requirements through the official OTC email. Do not send funds or assets based on general website information.
